scope: Exact active-IQ3 signed-magnitude segment-plane producer and H5Z-derived consumer on all 45 natural-M512 IQ3 layers of Laguna S 2.1 UD-Q2_K_XL on one Radeon Pro W7900 queue

baseline.iq3_route: H5Z exact K1024/N3072/E256 active-expert P64, activation-resident output P256, rowbatch8 BF16-to-BF16

candidate.operation: One producer writes an active-index-major [output][group8] plane whose aligned 16-byte records hold the exact current F32 scale, eight exact signed int8 magnitudes, and four zero padding bytes; an H5Z-derived consumer converts those integers exactly to F32 and replays the unchanged scalar BF16 dot, scale, wave tree, serial wave sum, rowbatch8/P64/P256 ownership, and BF16 store.

correctness.record_contract: Complete records for reordered active experts match the pinned IQ3 grids/sign selectors and current two-multiply F32 scale expression byte-for-byte, including zero padding.
correctness.output_contract: Complete candidate BF16 outputs match H5Z for reversed P64/P65 active lists and rowbatch/output tails; sampled rows/columns match the independent NumPy GGUF IQ3 oracle; empty active lists preserve output.

protocol.timing: producer-inclusive HIP events and synchronized host wall

consumer.activation_loads: eight global_load_b128 static sites, matching H5Z activation residency
consumer.record_load: one global_load_b96 static site; LLVM elided the unused four-byte padding, so the frozen one-b128 record-load gate failed

decision.reason: The candidate fails both required performance clocks on every actual IQ3 layer and also misses the one-b128 physical record-load contract because dead padding is compiled away.
decision.runtime_gate_disposition: not run because standalone producer-inclusive admission failed
decision.next_action: Rerank the unchanged post-H6A exact residual while treating immediate IQ3 ownership/tile/source-MMQ/segment-plane premises as closed; select a materially different exact operation before another RED.
